source.document_reference: APQC PCF Cross-Industry v8.0 (Feb 2026), process anchor pending verification (budget development); step decomposition per docs/HELDOUT_SPEC_2026-10-10.md (signed off 10 Oct 2026). APQC activity IDs pending verification against PCF v8.0 text.

steps.name: Issue calendar and central planning assumptions
steps.description: The budget calendar and central planning assumptions (inflation, FX, interest rates), including at least one downside macro scenario, are issued to all submitters.

steps.name: Set top-down targets
steps.description: Top-down revenue, margin and cost targets are set.

steps.name: Revenue and volume plans
steps.description: Business unit heads prepare and own revenue and volume plans.

steps.name: Cost centre and headcount budgets
steps.description: Cost centre owners prepare and own cost centre and headcount budgets.

steps.name: Capex requests
steps.description: Business unit heads submit capex requests, with a business case for requests above the threshold.
inputs: Business case for capex above threshold

steps.name: Consolidate into draft P&L, balance sheet, cash flow
steps.description: Submissions are consolidated into a draft three-statement budget prepared on the same accounting basis as actuals, with the three statements reconciled.

steps.name: Review and challenge iterations
steps.description: The draft budget is reviewed and challenged in iterations with submitters.

steps.name: Load and lock approved version
steps.description: The approved budget is loaded and locked as the single version used by variance analysis.

requirements.statement: Issue of the budget calendar and central planning assumptions must survive in some form.
Revenue and volume planning must survive in some form.
Cost centre and headcount budgeting must survive in some form.
Whatever carries capex requests must still consume a business case for capex above threshold.

required_inputs: Business case for capex above threshold

requirements.statement: Whatever carries consolidation of the draft budget must still consume the accounting policies applied to actuals (KB-06).
Consolidation into a draft P&L, balance sheet and cash flow must survive in some form.
Whatever carries consolidation of the draft budget must still consume the central FX assumptions (KB-07).
Board approval must occur before the approved version is loaded and locked.
Loading and locking of the approved version must survive in some form.
Whatever carries issue of the central planning assumptions must still consume a downside macro scenario.
Board approval must survive in some form.
